// diagnostic

E0935

A trait constant value is not known at compile time

What

A trait constant value is not known at compile time

Why

A trait constant is read from its type without running code, so its value is a literal, an enum case or a list of them

Fix

Write the value as a literal, an enum case or a list literal

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0935: tests/ui/trait_constant_not_compile_time_e0935.stderr.

Error [jet.TraitConstantNotCompileTime]: The value of trait constant `sides` is not known at compile time
  --> tests/ui/trait_constant_not_compile_time_e0935.jet:11:14
    |
 11 |     sides :: 2 + 2
    |              ^^^^^
 Why: A trait constant is read from its type without running code, so its value is a literal, an enum case or a list of them
 Fix: Write the value as a literal, an enum case or a list literal
